answer: Each agent stakes a refundable bond on a jetty‑anchored contract that records its public key and a proof‑of‑work nonce; the contract then runs a Bayesian truth serum round where rewards go to reports that increase the nebula of collective information, not to mere agreement. After scoring, bonds of low‑scoring identities are forfeited—a fable of loss—while high‑scorers receive their bond plus reward. An attacker must pay the full bond (e.g., 10 tokens) and the work nonce for every fake identity and wait the scoring period, costing bond + computation per Sybil.
